Fixed `_NumberRangeBase.convert` in `src/click/types.py` so the upper-bound clamp passes `max` (not `min`) to `_clamp`, making 15 clamp to 10.

Fixed `_make_default_short_help` in `src/click/utils.py` by changing `len(text) < max_length` to `<=`, so help text exactly at the limit is returned intact instead of being truncated with `...`.

Fixed `measure_table` in `src/click/formatting.py:19`: it used `min` instead of `max`, so column widths were always 0 and help descriptions weren't padded into a column.
